FOUNDER'S JOURNEY

My Story

My name is Kishan Mali, and my journey into farming was anything but traditional.

Before agriculture became my passion, I was focused on building my career and exploring new opportunities. Like many entrepreneurs, I was driven by the desire to create something meaningful, achieve growth, and leave a lasting impact through my work.

Everything changed during the COVID-19 period. As the world slowed down, I found myself reconnecting with nature. What initially began as an interest in developing farmland gradually transformed into a deep passion for agriculture and sustainable farming.

The journey was far from easy. There were challenges, unexpected setbacks, and valuable lessons that tested my patience and determination. Every mistake became an opportunity to learn, improve, and gain practical knowledge directly from real-world experiences.

"Success is not about how fast you grow. It's about how much you learn while growing."

As I spent more time in the agricultural field, I realized that reliable and practical farming knowledge is often difficult to access. Many farmers struggle because they lack proper guidance and real-world insights that can help them make better decisions.

That realization inspired a larger purpose. Today, my mission is not only to cultivate healthy crops but also to share experiences, knowledge, and practical insights that can help others grow with confidence.

Every season teaches something new. Every challenge creates new opportunities. And every step forward strengthens my belief that agriculture has the power to transform lives when supported by the right knowledge and innovation.

What began as curiosity has now become a passion, a purpose, and a lifelong journey.
